$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：破軍獨坐子午，《深造講義》p.126。

rules.text: 對面遷移宮的廉貞化忌，你的破軍基本上帶頑嚚的性質：破壞力大、創造力弱；有魁鉞、左右或祿存，可以調和。
rules.en: Lian Zhen opposite you is transformed by Ji, which gives your Po Jun a basically stubborn streak: much destructive force, little creative force; Kui, Yue, Zuo, You or Lu Cun can temper it.

rules.text: 文曲化忌同宮或對照，成破軍暗曜，其實也是頑嚚。
rules.en: Wen Qu transformed by Ji in your palace or opposite forms the 'darkened Po Jun', which is really just stubbornness.

rules.text: 你的破軍化祿，為人果敢，該斷就斷。
rules.en: Your Po Jun is transformed by Lu, which makes you bold and decisive, ready to cut when you must.

rules.text: 你的破軍化權，為人果敢，該斷就斷。
rules.en: Your Po Jun is transformed by Quan, which makes you bold and decisive, ready to cut when you must.

rules.text: 果敢的你，在七殺、破軍、貪狼的運裡，以行到七殺那一步最好。
rules.en: Being the decisive kind, among the phases through Qi Sha, Po Jun and Tan Lang, the one through Qi Sha serves you best.

source.quote: 果敢者以经行七杀宫度为佳

rules.text: 天同所在的運，只要天同不化忌、吉星多而煞星少，就是你創立事業的吉運。
rules.en: The phase through Tian Tong, so long as Tian Tong is not in Hindrance and helpful stars outweigh harsh ones, is your good time to found an enterprise.

source.quote: 能藉此创立事业的吉运

rules.text: 莽撞的你，行到七殺、破軍、貪狼的運，要有吉星（尤其天魁天鉞）才相宜；凡事三思而後行，就能避開困境。
rules.en: Being the rash kind, the phases through Qi Sha, Po Jun and Tan Lang suit you only with helpful stars, Tian Kui and Tian Yue above all; think three times before acting, and you can avoid the hard places.

rules.text: 天梁所在的那一步運，你只宜退居策劃，不宜衝在前面。
rules.en: In the phase through Tian Liang, step back and plan rather than lead from the front.
